Kim / Monica — thanks for the ping. We've seen this "blank Meet URL" behavior when the organizer address is being rewritten by an intermediary (forwarded invites, calendar connector, or when the organizer is on a personal account and attendees are on corporate domains). Two pragmatic ways to unblock quickly:

1) Republish the same event from our redwood.com domain (creates a fresh event UID) and attach an .ics we can send directly to external guests. That often avoids cross-domain stripping.
2) Create a one-off Zoom meeting and send a short calendar invite with the Zoom link (either as a separate event or as a follow-up email + ICS).

I'm attaching an .ics I generated pointing to a Zoom bridge (attached file: event_republish.ics). Suggest we:
- Republish event from kimberly_park@redwood.com using the attached .ics and mark Kimberly as organizer, OR
- If you want Zoom, I'll create the Zoom link, update the .ics, and email it to Tara + Evan directly (keeps their Outlook clients happy).

Proposed next step: Monica, can you confirm you want me to publish the Zoom link and send the ICS to GrowthOps? If yes, I'll publish and cc you on the outbound so it's in their inbox as a new event.

Attachments: event_republish.ics (text/calendar)
